event.title: Jury Begins Deliberations in Lindsay Clancy Murder Case
event.canonical_title: Jury Begins Deliberations in Lindsay Clancy Murder Case
event.summary: The jury is currently deliberating in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, who is accused of killing her three children. During closing arguments, the defense argued that Clancy was suffering from postpartum psychosis, while prosecutors claimed she intentionally planned the murders. The outcome now rests with the jury.

timeline.title: Jury Begins Deliberations in Lindsay Clancy Murder Case
timeline.summary: The jury in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial in Massachusetts has commenced deliberations following the closing arguments. Clancy's attorney characterized her as 'a darn good mother,' while the prosecution accused her of 'extreme atrocity and cruelty.'
key_facts: Jury has begun deliberations in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy.
Closing arguments included contrasting portrayals of Clancy by her lawyer and the prosecutor.
